title: Polish settings route target table
summary: Improve the WebView Settings TV/Movie route target table so the bucket rows, numeric controls, tolerance readouts, and derived height ranges are easier to scan.
reason: The existing table stretched across wide desktop viewports with weak visual grouping, making the route bucket fields hard to compare at a glance.
behavior_before: The Settings route target table rendered as a flat wide table with controls spread across the full panel and little distinction between bucket identity, editable numeric fields, tolerance readouts, and derived ranges.
behavior_after: The table keeps the same controls and IDs but presents route buckets with stronger column weighting, grouped field surfaces, tabular numeric readouts, and clearer range badges for faster scanning.
